hero.description: Kwita ku busugire bw'Igihugu tuzirikana iyo tuva ,dusigasira umuco twarazwe n'abakurambere .
hero.feature1.title: Guhuza no Gusangira
hero.feature1.desc: Jya mu muryango mpuzamahanga wiyemeje kubungabunga umuco w'u Rwanda.
hero.feature2.title: Iga Ikinyarwanda
hero.feature2.desc: Menya neza ururimi rw'igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi ukoresheje uburyo bugira uruhare.
hero.feature3.title: Sura Imigenzo
hero.feature3.desc: Wibumbire mu mateka avugwa, ingoma zirimo umuziki, n'ubuhanzi.
archive.title: Ububiko bw'Umurage wacu
archive.description: Imikino inogeye ijisho y'umuco w'u Rwanda, byose biri hamwe mu bubiko bwacu bw'ikoranabuhanga haba amajwi cyangwa mu nyandiko mu buryo bunogeye ijisho.
archive.collection1.title: Amateka Avugwa
archive.collection1.desc: Amajwi asobanutse neza y'inkuru z'abakurambere, abitswe burundu mu bubiko bwacu bw'ikoranabuhanga bwizewe.
archive.collection2.title: Inzu Ndangamurage Yikoranabuhanga
archive.collection2.desc: Amashusho ya 3D y'ibintu byakera, agufasha kureba buri kintu cyose kuri mudasobwa yawe.
archive.collection3.title: Umuziki Gakondo
archive.collection3.desc: Indirimbo z'Inanga n'Umuduri, zongeye gutunganywa kugira ngo zigire ijwi ryiza cyane.
community.proverbTranslation: Abantu benshi bishyize hamwe, ntakibananira . Mucyo tuwubungabunge.
community.exploreWisdom: Sura ubwenge bwimbitse bw'umuco w'u Rwanda.
community.joinNetwork: Jya mu muryango wacu w'ibigo, abahanga mu by'amateka, n'abantu ku giti cyabo biyemeje kubungabunga inkuru y'u Rwanda. Umusanzu wawe utuma amajwi y'uyu munsi aba ubwenge bw'ejo hazaza.
footer.tagline: Guhuza isi n'umutima w'u Rwanda. Menya ubwimbike bw'imigenzo yacu n'umwuka w'abaturage bacu.
footer.subscribeDesc: Akira amakuru y'umuco buri kwezi butaziguye muri imeli yawe.

collections.subtitle: Sura amakusanyirizo y'ingingo zihariye abitswe neza, ahuza imigenzo ya kera n'uburyo bugezweho bwo kubika ibintu mu ikoranabuhanga.
collections.inangaDesc: Isesengura ryimbitse ry'ihindagurika ry'igikinisho cy'imigozi gikomeye cy'u Rwanda, hakubiyemo amajwi guhera mu myaka ya 1920 kugeza ku bahanga bo muri iki gihe.
collections.royalCourtQuote: Kubika umwuka w'umuziki w'umunsi mukuru wa Umuganura n'amategeko yawo yo mu mihango yera.
collections.cantFindDesc: Abashinzwe amakusanyirizo bacu bahoraho bashyira ibintu bishya mu ikoranabuhanga. Iyandikishe kuri lisiti yacu kugira ngo umenyeshwe igihe amakusanyirizo mashya azasohoka.
listen.ruganzuTitle: Indirimbo ya Ruganzu II: Kugaruka k'Umwami
listen.ruganzuDesc: Inkuru ivugwa n'umugani ya Mzee Silas, yerekana ukuntu Umwami Ruganzu Ndoli yagarutse mu buryo bw'umugani. Menya umuziki w'ibisigo by'ingoro y'ubwami byo mbere y'igihe cy'ubukoloni.
listen.musicSectionDesc: Umva indirimbo gakondo z'u Rwanda — kuva ku mabwiriza ya inanga, ingoma, n'imvyino z'ibyishimo.
videos.intoreDesc: Kwerekana Intore, umucyo gakondo w'u Rwanda werekana imigenzo y'abarwanyi.
